name: PCR
description: This keyword will return a numerical value of the PUT-CALL ratio based on open interest at that instant. You can input the underlying instrument and expiry. Your request will be processed and a numeric response will be fetched. At the moment it is only available for indices.
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword will return a numerical value of the PUT-CALL ratio based on open interest at that instant. You can input the underlying instrument and expiry. Your request will be processed and a numeric response will be fetched. At the moment it is only available for indices.

The above image shows how to build a condition to check  the PCR  Nifty 50, current week options and take a trade if the same is greater than or equal to 1.25.

![Example](./images/img-1631871857.png)
